bullets.text: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at the new Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor progress on commuter safety.
Powered by NVIDIA, LiveX introduced human-like AI hosts offering multilingual guidance in public venues, and the office should watch this technology for potential civic integration.

stories.title: Train-platform gap yet to be rectified at Adambakkam
takeaways: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix platform gaps at Adambakkam station.
Commuter safety concerns persist until the railway platform modifications are completed.
